answer: An open agent economy is like a meadow where anyone can scatter seeds, and sybils are the cheap weeds. One concrete defense is a refundable bond: each new agent drops a small stake into escrow, like a marble into a jar, and gains grading weight only after weeks of peer-reviewed work. If graders catch it colluding with its clones, the bond is slashed. A thousand fakes then cost a thousand bonds, turning a cheap attack into one as heavy as basalt.
